name: Golden Designs Karlstad 6-Person Outdoor Hybrid Sauna (PureTech™ Full Spectrum Infrared & Harvia SWS80)
description: Golden Designs Karlstad 6-Person Outdoor Hybrid Sauna (PureTech™ Full Spectrum Infrared & Harvia SWS80) Immerse Yourself in Wellness Bliss with the Golden Designs Karlstad 6-Person Hybrid Outdoor Sauna Embark on a transformative journey of wellness with the Golden Designs Karlstad 6-Person Hybrid Outdoor Sauna. This exceptional outdoor sauna offers the perfect fusion of tradition and innovation, allowing you to indulge in the classic benefits of a traditional sauna or experience the rejuvenating power of full-spectrum infrared therapy. Unrivaled Versatility: The Karlstad sauna presents an unparalleled wellness experience. Choose the traditional sauna mode for the enveloping warmth of steam therapy, promoting relaxation and detoxification. Alternatively, bask in the gentle, therapeutic warmth of full-spectrum infrared therapy, renowned for its deep-reaching health benefits. Customize your sauna session to suit your unique wellness needs. Pure Elegance: Step into a world of pure elegance with the all-Canadian Red Cedar interior, known for its stunning aesthetics and delightful aromatic scent that enhances the sauna experience. The exterior boasts all-weather protective measures, ensuring the sauna remains resilient and captivating in all seasons. In winter, simply clear the roof of snow to continue enjoying the sauna's comforts. Spacious Retreat: Designed to comfortably accommodate up to six individuals, the Karlstad sauna is a generous retreat where you can share moments of relaxation with loved ones or savor peaceful solitude. Craftsmanship Perfected: Meticulously crafted to perfection, the Karlstad sauna showcases timeless design that effortlessly complements your outdoor living space. The large tempered glass door invites natural light, creating an inviting and soothing ambiance within. Elevate Your Wellness Journey: Elevate your wellness journey with the Golden Designs Karlstad 6-Person Hybrid Outdoor Sauna. Embrace the profound relaxation, detoxification, and rejuvenation that this versatile sauna offers, immersing yourself in a world of holistic well-being. Experience the harmonious blend of tradition and innovation and elevate your outdoor living with the Karlstad sauna - your pathway to wellness bliss. Features 6 person capacity All Weather Exterior / Canadian Red Cedar Interior Oversize interior chromotherapy lighting system Interior backrest with accent lighting Exterior accent lighting Interior LED Control Panel with built in FM Radio and Bluetooth Connection Built in Performance Speakers Sandglass, thermometer, bucket and scoop Stainless steel hinge and handle Full Spectrum IR: Total 13 IR Emitters. 4 Carbon PureTech™ Near Zero EMF Heat Emitters (Heating Panels) and 9 Near Infrared Heat Emitters (Heating Elements) Harvia SWS80 8 kW Traditional Sauna Stove with Built in Controls Specifications Electrical service: 240V / 40AMP (Stove & Full Spectrum). Please consult a certified electrician. Assembled Dimensions Exterior (W x D x H): 79.2" x 84.7" x 88.3" Assembled Dimensions Interior (W x D x H): 75" x 67.2" x 75" Assembled Weight 1275 LBS Shipping Weight 1575 LBS All Golden Designs Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty.
